subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep the PR draft until the Scout/Lobster pilot and stress harness prove the scope?
rationale: Automation can identify the code and supply-chain blockers, but it cannot decide the permanent core-versus-host/plugin boundary or the proof threshold for a new backup artifact schema containing sensitive SQLite state.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
options.body: Require lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept the local-only core command once the concrete blockers are fixed and product/secops reviewers approve the sensitive artifact boundary.

options.title: Move Host-Specific First
options.body: Defer the core command and keep the behavior in a host/plugin path until a missing OpenClaw core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
recommendation.body: Require lockfile and stale-policy cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and has already reviewed the snapshot artifact contract and metadata invariant in this PR.
